baseline.notes: Lock, formatter-selected modules, smoke, four offline examples and independent analytical expectations passed. This is the unmodified v0.1.0 baseline, not a new implementation result.

features.description: Explicit index and reviewed change intent
acceptance_criteria: Reject duplicate or absent selected IDs, duplicate keys, invalid enums, fractional/exponent counts and unknown schemas; explicit null remains unknown.
A feature that introduces a confirmed defect remains feature-intent with a separate causal outcome. A feature-only follow-up is not a repair.
Commit-proxy or interval-ambiguous acceptance cannot silently enter an exact-window mature stratum. Reviewed disposition and provenance survive round trip.
features.notes: Strict explicit index IDs/decisions, acceptance partitions, intent/outcome separation and unexpected-field controls; native index controls/property pass.

acceptance_criteria: Selected index partitions account for every selected row; an out-of-index follow-up or excluded smoke cannot change index denominator/outcomes.
The same added row changes the correctly labelled workload count and known usage subtotal, with missingness retained.
A touch, five files and three repair rounds do not become equivalent defect counts; zero denominator is unavailable. Order-invariance and partition properties execute.
features.notes: Named populations, observed rename/delete/copy identity, exact follow-up windows and actual Parse replay; late and renamed controls pass; ascertainment/trace coverage explicit.

acceptance_criteria: A legacy chain scalar retains only its recorded known total; missing split/model/billing cannot become zero or a fresh-token claim.
Wrong types, duplicate IDs/keys, invalid or negative counts, unknown contracts and unsupported precision are rejected or explicitly unavailable under the field policy.

Money remains decimal text. Exact USD micro-unit aggregation uses scale 6 without rounding; excess nonzero precision/overflow is unavailable, trailing zero precision is accepted. Other currencies remain recorded but cannot silently join USD.
features.notes: Versioned exact neutral receipts, explicit accounting/nulls, strict object shapes/counts and fixed-point USD schema;45 usage tests plus generated laws included.

acceptance_criteria: Independent fixtures: inclusive input 150 minus cache 80+20 gives fresh 50; visible 7 plus reasoning 3 gives accounted total 160 and fresh+generated 60. Exclusive-input fixture agrees.
Combined generated 10 with reasoning 3 yields visible 7, never generated 13. Impossible cache splits fail; unknown reason/cache reporting never becomes proven zero.
Parent plus leaf costs are charged once; conflicting duplicate identities fail; possible cross-source overlap is unavailable. Costly failed attempts remain charged.
Mixed metered/list-price/local/unknown cost bases are separated. Known subtotal and coverage are distinct from total expenditure and cost per success.
features.notes: Inclusive/exclusive/cache/reasoning and fresh+generated reconciliation; leaf dedup/parent/overlap, failed retries and overhead; unknown generation control passes.

acceptance_criteria: A synthetic 8-trajectory/24-stage schedule accounts for started, completed, failed, blocked, invalid, budget-stopped and never-started rows without counting non-launch as a model error.
Check prior/output checkpoint identities and the fixed stage schedule; a broken S1 remains the trajectory source for S2 rather than receiving a gold replacement.
Missing stage, duplicate attempt, wrong checkpoint and forged oracle provenance fail. Usage stays attached to spent attempts even if the terminal artifact fails.
features.notes: Full8/24 schedule with owned prior/output identity, model/harness/settings/check/oracle validation and blocked/unstarted/invalid separation.

acceptance_criteria: Reject duplicate arm keys and unintended config changes; preserve unmatched and invalid arms plus their spend. Never relabel language to call core PairArms.
Chain success requires every mandatory stage and retained invariant to pass independent checks. Visible-green hidden-regression is reported separately.

All failed work contributes to matched-cohort economic totals; unmatched/invalid overhead remains separately visible. Zero success, incomplete oracle outcomes or missing usage makes affected economic comparisons unavailable.
Two repeated families remain two clusters. Reports publish descriptive paired counts, never an unsupported population significance or representative-working-day claim.
features.notes: Matched-arm stage-contract/provider checks, unconditional outcomes/economics and distinct unmatched/overhead; exact edit aggregation and positive/negative economic fixtures pass.

acceptance_criteria: A missing reproducer, weakened oracle, unsupported causal link or all-pass tiny sample cannot emit a qualified language win or design_ready recommendation.
A reproduction can support an investigation card with unknown cost, while an economic claim requires its own coverage. A single severe case requires an explicit severity exception.

Seed discovery/reproduced cards cite the merged ownership/text cases; current application fixes remain recorded. No automatic stdlib deficiency, agent message, dispatch, approval or implementation is generated.
features.notes: Reproduction drafts with immutable/distinct identities, mutation/reuse/recurrence policy. Standalone economic/language advantage qualification rejects; review amendment documented.

acceptance_criteria: Same frozen inputs give identical JSON/Markdown/card bytes. Changed index, receipt, protocol or comparison direction changes the report identity.
Invalid input exits nonzero with field/context; no fallback to an empty successful cohort. Missing costs and observational/controlled evidence remain separate.
The installed offline command runs outside the source checkout under IO/FS/Env only; it does not request Process, Net or AI. Do not forge a 0.1.0 identity in 0.2.0 output.
features.notes: Deterministic explicit serializers and offline maintenance-ledger installed command; actual0.2 identities and declared build-attestation limitation; eight examples executed.

features.description: Resource ownership starter pair and contract
acceptance_criteria: Both native starters pass the same baseline cases, including different bytes with repeated names, duplicate content and reordered documents. Record source/runtime/dependency identities.

External checks detect planted byte corruption and cross-document aliasing while public checks remain unchanged. A nonzero exit before successful compilation is infrastructure evidence, not the desired semantic negative control.
Attribute the seed and adaptation honestly; all exposed controls are development assets. Baseline native responsibility and allowed dependencies are documented before stage qualification.
features.notes: Both native competent resource starters pass shared obligations; separate oracle detects actual byte/ownership failures; source attribution and same responsibility frozen.

acceptance_criteria: Both languages pass each stage reference and all still-required older obligations. No-op/pre-fix and targeted weakened-oracle/implementation mutations fail actual assertions.
Rejected or partially processed documents cannot corrupt earlier successes; cap boundaries, retry, shared content and release/unreleased ownership are exercised.
Use per-source build/output directories and an explicit qualification script outside agent workspace. Record byte checks and timing; no uncalibrated RSS or physical-race pass claim.
features.notes: 16 positives/14 semantic negatives,1136 assertions,12 native tests/4cap proofs; typed-output and create-only/weak-oracle controls pass; amended receipt committed.

features.description: Text fidelity starter pair and contract
acceptance_criteria: Both starters preserve baseline logical text, internal/non-ASCII whitespace, decoded character references and empty/error distinctions on shared cases.
Specify identical semantic responsibility for S2 producer/interface events and S3 structured-text/output fields; provide both arms equally competent native producers/dependencies.

Independent oracle catches a planted semantic loss after a successful build. Reject unmatched responsibility rather than publishing an AILANG/Python delta; do not present Python assets as historical repairs.
features.notes: Native logical-text starters with frozen decoded-event boundary, same semantic responsibility, source attribution and independent typed oracle.

acceptance_criteria: Both native reference chains pass the identical frozen stage expectations, including event chunk boundaries and relevant CDATA/rich-text/schema cases selected before execution.
No-op/pre-fix controls and targeted mutants fail specific old/new assertions; oracle weakening is detected by the independent expected-failure ledger.
Malformed versus empty output and missing consumer fields cannot pass. Fresh build identities and exact source requirements are included in qualification receipts.
features.notes: 22 variants/98positive assertions/144 intended semantic failures; native9 tests,2proofs/3encoding skips; typed scalar and weakened-oracle controls pass.

acceptance_criteria: Account for the complete synthetic 8/24 schedule with forced failures, blocked continuation and costly retries; label its instrument-control role visibly.
Run F1/F2 native starter/reference/no-op/mutation checks independently, record pass/fail counts and assert their intended failure causes. A skipped/weak oracle or stale build cannot qualify a family.
Replay the old consumer with its actual 0.1.0 lock/compiler and compare original reports byte-for-byte. New v2 reports use a separate series; do not edit frozen pilot/mature studies.
features.notes: Main185 native+500generated, installed/frozen snapshots and actual scoped replay; both qualification/control suites pass; all6old reports byte-identical on pinned old source/compiler.

features.description: Release candidate, focused CI and evaluation
acceptance_criteria: Record actual named/inline/property counts, compile/effects/interface/release/docs badges, smoke and SMT proved/counterexample/unknown/skipped outcomes. No undiscovered-test or vacuous-contract pass.

Keep baseline 75 uncontracted-export PUB011 limit from growing: add meaningful contracts to new exports or keep helpers internal. Disclose encoding skips as runtime assertions; no widened warning allowlist.
Verify clean dependency resolution and installed commands; provide scoped source PR with exact tested revision. Do not claim main/registry availability or CI success before verified.

Run sprint-evaluator against both designs and acceptance controls; resolve material failures before calling the sprint complete. No core compiler/harness edits or default rotation changes belong to this sprint.
